title: A clearer Windows experience.
summary: Simpler setup, complete allowance details and a steadier compact monitor.

sections.title: Getting started
items: A clean Light setup with sharp Llumi artwork, illustrated PowerShell walkthroughs and animated provider switches.
Setup always uses Light. Existing preferences move to Light once; your later appearance choices stay saved.
Turn Codex and Claude Code monitoring on or off during setup and in Settings. Disabled providers stop monitoring and leave the Usage view and monitor; both can be off.
Check Setup separates sign-in readiness from monitoring availability, with Retry when another check can run.

sections.title: Usage and allowances
items: See every supported general, model and additional time allowance, with clear labels, remaining percentages and reset times when reported.
The compact monitor prioritizes a general five-hour limit, then a general weekly limit, then the shortest other supported general window. Model limits stay in the details.
Clearer Not reported, Unsupported format, Unsupported billing, Unavailable and Stale states preserve the difference between unknown, zero and exhausted allowances.
Fixes intermittent Claude readings disappearing after a failed usage request. Previous readings remain visibly Stale only after the same account is verified; account changes and sign-out clear them.
Retries and reset refreshes respect provider limits, with bounded waits after repeated failures and no overlapping requests.
Softer cards, rounded controls and quieter date labels keep Usage focused on your allowances.

sections.title: Your monitor
items: Drag without triggering hover expansion, with a movement threshold that follows display scaling.
Keep a stable position when expanding details or changing displays. Reset Position returns it to its default location.
Expanded details include provider names and observation dates. Open Usage shows additional limits when space is limited.
Clearer keyboard focus, accessible allowance details and brief animations that respect Windows motion preferences.

sections.title: About Llumi
items: Find the installed version in About and open release notes on the Llumi website. Simpler menus remove repeated actions.
Windows updates continue to be managed by Microsoft Store.

notice: Approved for release on 8 October 2026. Microsoft Store submission and publication are not yet verified; this preview does not claim Store availability.
